_comment: Hand-written synthetic postings for the standalone demo. Every company, role, link and sentence is fictional and was written for this file; nothing is copied or paraphrased from a real posting. Dates are stored as days_ago and resolved against the generation date so the demo never goes stale. Source names (seek / linkedin / indeed) are generic format enums only. Label text fields (note, ineligible_reason) are {en, zh} pairs; jobs.demo picks one with --lang (default en). Posting text itself stays English.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.teaser: Join a small product team building scheduling software.
jobs.description: Quillfeather Systems is a fictional company used for this demo. As a graduate engineer you will build and test features for an internal scheduling product alongside a friendly team. You will work mostly in Python and SQL, use Git every day, and learn how we ship with Docker. No commercial experience is needed; we will provide training and a named mentor. Applicants must hold full work rights in Australia.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.description: Duplicate listing of the Quillfeather graduate role, cross-posted on a second platform with different company punctuation. Python, SQL, Git and Docker. Training provided for graduates and career changers.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.description: Third copy of the same fictional graduate role, aggregated from the employer careers page. Python and SQL; mentoring and training provided.

jobs.title: Junior Security Analyst (SOC)
jobs.teaser: Monitor alerts, triage incidents, grow into threat hunting.
jobs.description: Harbourlight Security Labs is a fictional company. You will triage alerts in our Splunk-based SIEM, document findings and escalate incidents to senior analysts. Comfort with Linux and basic scripting is expected; we will teach the rest. This is an entry-level seat in a rostered team. Candidates may be Australian citizens, permanent residents or hold a valid work visa.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Graduate Program 2027
jobs.description: A fictional twelve-month rotation across advisory, testing and response teams. Graduates join a cohort of six. Australian citizenship is mandatory for this program because of the nature of the client work.

jobs.title: Defence Software Tester
jobs.teaser: Test mission software for a fictional defence integrator.
jobs.description: Ironbark Defence Systems is fictional. You will design and run test plans for embedded mission software. The role requires an active NV1 security clearance, and you will be sponsored for higher levels over time. Experience with Python test harnesses is useful.

jobs.title: IT Support Officer
jobs.description: A fictional community health provider needs a service desk officer for first-line support. You will reset passwords in Active Directory, look after Windows laptops and log tickets. Shifts are split across two clinic sites. Customer-friendly communication matters more than prior experience.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (Cloud)
jobs.description: Tidewater Cloud Co is fictional. You will own Terraform modules and Kubernetes clusters on AWS for internal product teams. You have 5+ years of experience running production infrastructure and are comfortable being on a light on-call rota.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.teaser: Payments back end for a fictional fintech.
jobs.description: Copperfield Fintech is a made-up company. You will design Java and Spring Boot services backed by PostgreSQL and mentor two junior developers. You bring at least 6 years of experience building reliable APIs. Hybrid, with two office days in Brisbane. No salary is listed on the advertisement.

jobs.title: Test Automation Analyst
jobs.description: Larkspur Retail Tech is fictional. Build Selenium and Python test suites for an online store, run them in Jenkins and report defects clearly. We value curiosity and clear writing. The salary line on this advert is text only, which the parser cannot read as a number.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - 6 month contract
jobs.description: Saltbush Analytics is a fictional consultancy. Support a reporting migration using SQL and Tableau; Python is a bonus. Fully remote within Australia, six-month initial term with possible extension.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React)
jobs.description: Wattlebird Studio is an invented studio. You will build accessible React and TypeScript interfaces and review pull requests from teammates. Salary: $90,000 - $105,000 plus super, stated in the body only (the structured salary field is empty). Familiarity with plain JavaScript and automated tests is a plus.

jobs.title: Network Support Engineer
jobs.description: Kestrel Networks is fictional. Support small-business customers' routers, switches and wireless, with Linux-based monitoring. Regional travel is occasional. A driver's licence is required for site visits.

jobs.title: Network Support Engineer L2
jobs.description: Near-duplicate of the Kestrel posting: the title differs by a level suffix, which the fuzzy matcher should still group with the other Kestrel listing. Linux monitoring and customer-site support.

jobs.title: Graduate Program - Technology
jobs.teaser: Rotations across engineering, data and operations.
jobs.description: Brightwater Group is fictional. This graduate program rotates across engineering, data and operations teams. Applicants must be Australian citizens, permanent residents or hold a valid work visa. You will meet a buddy in week one and present a showcase project at the end of each rotation.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Architect
jobs.description: Orrery Consulting is fictional. Lead cloud architecture engagements on AWS for large clients, set standards for infrastructure code and coach delivery teams. You have more than 10 years of experience and strong stakeholder skills.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer (Graduate)
jobs.description: Fernhollow Logistics is fictional. Graduates will maintain CI pipelines in Jenkins, automate server setup with Ansible and keep Linux hosts healthy. A driver's licence is helpful for occasional depot visits. Training provided.

jobs.title: Junior Support Consultant
jobs.description: Pebblecreek Software is fictional. This advert has been live for 45 days, so the panel shows its age tag and keeps it out of the Recommended view. Answer customer tickets for a scheduling product and write short help articles.

jobs.title: QA Intern
jobs.teaser: Short teaser only; the full description has not been fetched yet.
